description: Each cross-job/phase collision group requires finalized authority bound to its exact canonical settlement, pinned rail/profile, job, and phase; without that complete relation every competitor is indeterminate.

vectors.name: single-record-no-collision-counts
vectors.note: SB-2 does not require settlement-side authority until a collision appears.

vectors.name: idempotent-identical-record-counts-once
vectors.note: Repeated presentation of the same evidence hash is idempotent.

vectors.name: cross-job-finalized-binding-selects-a
vectors.note: The settlement's finalized job binding selects A and rejects B.

vectors.name: backdated-attacker-does-not-win
vectors.note: B has earlier observedAt but cannot override the binding to A.

vectors.name: equal-producer-timestamps-do-not-tie-break
vectors.note: Equal timestamps and hash order are irrelevant when authority binds A.

vectors.name: reverse-arrival-order-same-authority
vectors.note: Input and arrival order cannot change the selected tuple.

vectors.name: cross-phase-eip3009-exact-binding-selects-phase-one
vectors.note: The EIP-3009 nonce authenticates both jobId and phaseIndex.

vectors.name: no-binding-collision-voids-both
vectors.note: An unbound rail collision suspends both claims.

vectors.name: attacker-anchors-stolen-claim-first
vectors.note: B's earlier SR-2 anchor and timestamp do not grant commercial authority.

vectors.name: authority-unavailable-voids-both
vectors.note: Unavailable authority is non-countable, not first-observed wins.

vectors.name: authority-not-final-voids-both
vectors.note: A non-final binding cannot choose a durable winner.

vectors.name: authority-pruned-voids-both
vectors.note: Pruned authority does not fall back to timestamps.

vectors.name: authority-reorged-before-finality-voids-both
vectors.note: A pre-finality reorganisation suspends the whole collision group.

vectors.name: conflicting-finalized-authority-voids-both
vectors.note: Conflicting purported finality cannot silently transfer credit.

vectors.name: malformed-authority-errors
vectors.note: Malformed authority is an error, not an ordering fallback.

vectors.name: binding-to-unpresented-tuple-rejects-both
vectors.note: Neither claim matches the settlement's authenticated tuple.

vectors.name: later-anchor-hint-cannot-replace-finalized-binding
vectors.note: A later outer anchor claiming B cannot replace finalized binding to A.

vectors.name: unsupported-atomic-first-claim-hint-is-inert
vectors.note: No atomic first-claim mechanism is registered in this revision.

vectors.name: two-groups-one-authority-does-not-substitute
vectors.note: Authority for the first canonical settlement cannot select the same tuple in the second group.

vectors.name: two-groups-each-exact-authority-selects-independently
vectors.note: Each collision group is selected only by its own exact settlement relation.

vectors.name: authority-missing-settlement-id-does-not-select
vectors.note: A relation without the canonical settlement identifier proves no authority for this group.

vectors.name: authority-mismatched-settlement-id-does-not-select
vectors.note: Authority authenticated for another settlement cannot be substituted into this group.

vectors.name: authority-missing-rail-profile-does-not-select
vectors.note: A relation without the authenticated pinned profile proves no authority for this group.

vectors.name: authority-mismatched-rail-id-does-not-select
vectors.note: Authority under another pinned rail cannot select this group's record.

vectors.name: authority-mismatched-profile-does-not-select
vectors.note: A Permit2 proof cannot substitute for the pinned EIP-3009 profile.

vectors.name: eip3009-missing-phase-proof-is-indeterminate
vectors.note: An incomplete EIP-3009 relation cannot select a phase.

vectors.name: permit2-job-only-cross-phase-is-indeterminate
vectors.note: The existing Permit2 witness authenticates jobId but not phaseIndex.

vectors.name: ap2-job-only-cross-phase-is-indeterminate
vectors.note: The existing AP2 provider metadata authenticates jobId but not phaseIndex.

vectors.name: permit2-caller-phase-claim-adds-no-authority
vectors.note: A phase field cannot add an authentication dimension that Permit2 does not sign.

vectors.name: unproven-authority-source-does-not-select
vectors.note: A producer report is not independently authenticated settlement authority.

vectors.name: protocol-input-authority-claim-is-inert
vectors.note: Claimant-controlled protocol input cannot manufacture trusted authority.

vectors.name: distinct-event-identifiers-both-count
vectors.note: Different log indices are different canonical settlement identifiers.
